== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The term "Ghost" refers to several distinct entities and groups within the narrative. Most notably, [[Durandiel]], also known as the Ghost, is a powerful woman with black hair and a gray dress who serves as a manifestation of the [[Slumbering Wraith]]. She possesses the ability to manipulate reality, collapse warped dimensions, and fold individuals into pockets of space. [[Durandiel]] appears to possess knowledge regarding the fundamental mechanics of existence and can interact with otherworldly strings of power. Another significant entity is the [[Empty Ghost]], a figure described as a hollow mockery of humanity and a potential replacement for the [[Silent King]]. This entity is associated with the title of the fourth [[Dreadgod]] and is recognized as an extraordinary threat. Additionally, the [[Ghost Division]] is a group responsible for maintaining and repairing the laws of reality in worlds that are either being born or facing [[destruction]]. Members of this division, such as [[Hallister Halloway]], work to preserve coherent existence. Other instances of ghosts include various spirits, such as the blue [[construct]] used for testing recruits, the "[[Ghost-Blades]]" who seek combat, and various [[Remnants]] or shadows that can manifest as terrifying, non-human entities.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|As a member of the [[Court]] of Seven, this individual focuses on worlds that are either being born or facing death.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Ghost possesses powers that Ozriel utilized to reinforce reality and can use their touch to wipe away the abilities of [[Eithan]]. This entity is capable of fighting on even terms against the [[Wandering Titan]].}}
